about: Every barcode sticker printed on the AIDP-2K consignment documents, with what the page geometry allows. A sticker is clipped or covered when no complete scan line along its bars lies on the page inside the printable box (14 mm margins) and under no later sticker; the share of such lines is clear_fraction. Rotated means whole but tilted past the angle at which a straight row can cross every bar. Computed from each PDF: the sticker images and their placement on the page.
